mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 6%, indicating a tight labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 60 trading days, as a strong labor market boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 6%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month, signaling strong supply-side growth, tends to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns remains below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of rising GDP (GDPC1) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as both signals confirm robust economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month, indicating potential inflationary pressures, tends to lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) and high payroll employment (PAYEMS > 140000) indicates a very strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as economic growth is robust.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery regime, a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 units signals a return of consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the economy rebounds.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of post-shock recovery instances when HOUST > 1000.
